# testdata

`lexicons/` holds the `com.atproto.space.*` lexicons, copied unchanged from
https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto (branch `permissioned-data`, commit
`9ded2074afbc1b244871cca738909e05b637ada2`), directory `lexicons/com/atproto/space/`.

`lexicons_test.go` checks the Go types against them.
When the lexicons change, copy the new ones here and fix whatever the test reports.
